about_the_game:
Practice drumming in VR. Learn a new talent you can apply in real life using VR Drums Ultimate Streamer. 

Realistic customizable VR drum kit simulator.

  • Pressure sensitive hits.

  • Save multiple kits, backup or share.

  • Unlimited spawning, drag 'n drop or use the prebuilt drum kits.

  • Rhythm Game Included (Add custom songs)

The rhythm game highways 2D&3D support adding your own custom music drum charts such as Clone Hero / Moonscraper drum (.chart) files.

LIV support for use with your own VR avatars or VR green screen setups.

Follow the updates on X @aliencybercoat

Choose your drummer and customize them.

Choose a look for each individual drum.

Some Details:

  • Positioned drum kit comes already setup! Modify it to your liking or start from scratch.

  • In-game .MP3 / .OGG / .WAV player. Add your own album art. See the customizable albums in-game.

  • Use optional foot pedals for bass and hi-hat pedals or use your VR controller buttons. Plenty of ways to get a physical hardware foot pedal working or rig up your own.

    In-game bass pedal in action. (Now with double bass)

  • Pressure sensitive hits. Softer and harder hits are detected.

  • Add drums, cymbals, cowbells, splashes, china. Position them where you want.

  • Comes stock with all the goodies most drummers want. 7 snare drums, 5 bass drums, also an amped bass drum, 7+ crash cymbals, 2 ride cymbals, 3 splash cymbals, tom drums 6", 8", 10", 12", 14" with multiple tom drum heads for different sounds. A roto tom rack 6", 8", 10" roto toms, 4 different hi-hats (rock, 50's and metal trash), china cymbals, dry crash, a custom china stack, mounted tambourine, steelpan, xylophone and more.

  • Save the position of the default drum kit and load it back-in next time you play. Unlimited.

  • Over 90 drumming sounds and pitch effects to make more.

  • Tenor drumming mode.

  • Controller haptic force feedback. (Option to enable)

  • Attention gone into creating realistic looking drums, cymbals, textures and realistic finishes.

  • Play drum charts (.chart files) created by you or others (Example: Moonscraper Chart Editor, Feedback Chart Editor, or even .chart Clone Hero charts)

  • VR GrabCam. Grab the camera, place it anywhere.

  • Realistic instrumental sounds.

  • Liv.tv support for custom VR avatars or advanced VR green screen setups.

Multiple hardware Hi-hats. Close it, strike it open or closed, hear the changes. Use your VR controllers or connect a physical USB foot pedal or gamepad device. Use it like a real hi-hat.

Technical Information
Will VR Drums Ultimate Streamer work with my VR headset?

The app is programmed to track headsets and devices that support OpenXR and has been tested on multiple PC's and different devices. Please see below for devices that are compatible with XR.

✔🟢Oculus -- Compatible

✔🟢Meta Quest -- Steam with Meta Link (Small latency but playable, we made a lot of the videos on our site using Steam and the Meta Quest Link USB) -- There is also a native running Quest version on Meta store with passthrough. 

✔🟢Vive -- Compatible

✔🟢Valve Index -- Compatible

✔🟢Pico -- SteamVR OpenXR -- In Testing

📜VRDUS Game Manual listed on the sidebar, click "Visit the website" link.

name: VR Drums Ultimate Streamer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10,11
  • Processor: 2 Ghz +
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: A "VR Ready" Graphics Card and PC. RTX+ it really depends your PC's performance level of tuning. Minimum GTX series GPU's.
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR supported devices Oculus, Meta Quest 2/3 (PC-Link), Valve Index, VIVE, and more. See manual.
  • Additional Notes: OpenXR supported XR headset and XR controllers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10,11
  • Processor: 2.5 Ghz +
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: A "VR Ready" Graphics Card and PC. Minimum RTX+
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR supported devices Oculus, Meta Quest 2/3 (PC-Link), Valve Index, VIVE, VIVE and more. See manual.
  • Additional Notes: OpenXR supported XR headset and XR controllers.

short_description: Customizable VR drum kit simulator and rhythm game. Pressure sensitive hits, foot pedal options, save and load, freestyle practice or load a beat map drum chart. LIV avatar support.
